description: A flex-wrap image grid. Use for client logo strips (no labels) or icon-category tiles (with labels). Items always have an image; labels are optional.

id.description: Optional HTML id attribute for anchor linking (e.g. navigation anchors).

title.description: Optional section heading above the grid.

theme.description: Background color/tone for this band. 'default' = the band's own default background (no tone override). 'muted' = light tinted surface band (renders the --color-surface background with framing top and bottom borders). 'inverted' = inverted dark background for strong contrast; use 'inverted' for a genuinely dark band.

items.description: Array of image items. Each: { image_url: string, image_alt: string, image_id?: number, label?: string }. Omit label for pure logo display; include label for icon+category tiles.

image_alt.description: Alt text. Use the logo or category name; empty string only for decorative images.

image_id.description: Media Library attachment ID (NOT a URL). When it resolves to a real attachment, the image renders responsively with srcset/sizes via wp_get_attachment_image() instead of a single fixed-size . Falls back to image_url when unset or unresolvable. Get an attachment id via the import_media apply.

label.description: Text label below the image. Omit for logo-only rows.

items.conditionality_note: the height cap applied to a logo image is chosen by that item's `label` — 2.5rem labelled, 3rem unlabelled, and --logos-image-size overrides both — an item-level condition the clause grammar, which reaches component props only, cannot express

--logos-padding-top.description: Top padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm (fluid ~68-80px desktop, ~54px mobile); set an explicit length to override.

--logos-padding-bottom.description: Bottom padding of the band. Defaults to the shared symmetric band rhythm; set an explicit length to override.

--logos-heading-size.description: Section heading font size. Defaults to the shared responsive band-heading scale (fluid ~28px mobile to ~42px desktop), which every band heading in the theme routes. LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ from the rest of the site: retuning every band heading at once is ONE update_design_token write on --pp-band-heading-size, not one slot write per band.

--logos-heading-color.description: Section heading color. Defaults to the theme text colour (the inverted variant supplies its own light default). LEAVE IT UNSET unless THIS band must differ: recolouring every heading on the site is ONE update_design_token write on --color-text, not one slot write per band.

--logos-heading-measure.description: Maximum width of the logos section heading. Routes the shared --measure-heading design token (40rem) by default, so retuning that ONE token changes every routed band heading at once; set a length here only when THIS band must differ from the rest of the site.

--logos-heading-margin-bottom.description: Space below the logos section heading, before the strip (header rhythm). Lower it to tighten the header, raise it for more separation. Not a band-fusing lever: the strip always renders after the heading, so the seam with the band below is closed with --logos-padding-bottom.

--logos-image-size.description: Maximum height of every logo image in the strip (the images keep their aspect ratio and are never cropped). Unset, the shipped label-driven switch applies: 3rem for an item with no label, 2.5rem for a labelled tile. SET, it caps BOTH at the one value and that switch stops applying — one knob for one visual job, matching --grid-item-icon-size. Raise it for a sparse strip of wordmarks, lower it for a dense wall. On a MIXED strip the shipped switch exists so an image+label tile totals about the same height as a bare mark; with this slot set, labelled tiles become taller than their neighbours by the label height, so prefer it on strips that are all-labelled or all-unlabelled. It changes SIZE only: it is not a fix for dark-ink logo artwork on a dark band.

--logos-gap.description: Space between logo items, both across a row and between wrapped rows. Tighten it for a dense logo wall, open it out for a few large marks. This is the strip's rhythm; the small gap between a tile's image and its label is not authorable.
